# Croatia

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 0% | 86% (estimate, low confidence, 78.9–92.9%) | not applicable | 0.8% (estimate, low confidence, 0.6–1.3%) |

The Constitution is held with its full in-force history (1990-2013) and checks out, but every other act (36,796) is the text as first printed in Narodne novine with no later amendment applied: the Criminal Code, Criminal Procedure Act and Obligations Act are held only in their original wording (the Criminal Code lacks the 2024 femicide article and the changed art. 111), the Civil Procedure Act is missing, and some replaced laws (Zakon o radu 2009, Carinski zakon 1999) are still labelled as live. Croatia has no legislating regions; case law is limited to 1,141 Constitutional Court decisions published in the gazette.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
